about_the_game:
Thrown into a world consumed by infection, a lone cube-shaped survivor awakens with no memory, no guidance, just instincts and the need to survive.

______________________________________________________________

Welcome to Cube Slayer

A fast-paced, top-down endless 2D survival shooter where you fight through waves of relentless zombies in ever-expanding infected maps. Armed only with random weapons at the start, you must collect experience from fallen enemies to level up and unlock stronger, deadlier versions of your arsenal.

The longer you survive, the tougher the horde becomes. Every second is a challenge. Every kill is progress. Level up, choose from three random upgrades, and stack weapon evolutions to create devastating combos.

When death finally comes--and it will--your run ends, but your progress doesn’t. Use collected resources to purchase permanent buffs, unlock new maps, and uncover hidden Easter eggs scattered throughout the infected world.

All the while, something… watches. A mysterious figure lurks in the distance, silent, motionless, and always there. What is it? Why is it watching you? Will it encounter you? And why were you dropped into this world in the first place? 

Prepare for chaos, mystery, and high replayability. How long can you survive… and how far can you go before the truth catches up to you?

Can you find the snakes?

Upgrade Arsenal

Every level you can choose your new weapon or stack different weapons to make powerful combos!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Storage: 120 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Survive an endless onslaught in this fast-paced top-down shooter! Pick random weapons, level up to upgrade them, and battle swarms of zombies. Collect EXP, unlock maps, and buy permanent buffs to push your limits. How long can you survive?
